summary: Coordinate energy controls, clean energy choices and sustainability reporting. Explore the five-day course and review the practical outline.
lede: Clean energy management connects energy reviews, facility data and sustainability decisions. For energy managers, sustainability officers and facilities leads, this course develops skills to set boundaries and baselines, choose performance indicators, and prioritize operational controls and clean energy options. Exercises use sample facility data and Excel to build action registers, compare options and plan reporting responsibilities.
audienceIntro: This course suits intermediate practitioners who make or support energy, facilities and sustainability decisions across operational teams.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with energy use, facilities operations or sustainability responsibilities is expected. No programming is required; exercises use sample data and spreadsheet calculations.
